source: src-tauri/src/engine/kb_extract.rs:167-203 (extract_document prompt, pass 2), schema rendering render_schema_for_prompt at :409-420, wire types ExtractionResponse/ExtractedRow at :424-440, EXTRACTION_MODEL at :30, 180s timeout at :189
notes: Pass 2 (per-document extraction) is lifted, not pass 1 (schema inference): pass 2 has a fixed, checkable answer; pass 1's 'good schema' is a judgement. Facts are matched against the serialized rows after lowercasing and removing whitespace, so '450 mm' == '450mm'. `facts[].any` = alternatives, any one counts. `absentFields`: schema fields the document does NOT state - the prompt says 'omit fields not stated', so a non-empty value there is an invented fact. `absentStrings`: tempting values that are not in the document at all. `rowCounts`: exact count of rows per entityType.

tasks.title: Incident report INC-882
tasks.text:
INC-882 postmortem. Severity: SEV2. Customer impact from 14:05 to 14:52 UTC (47 minutes): webhook deliveries delayed.
Initial suspicion was the database failover, but that was ruled out. Confirmed root cause: an expired TLS certificate on the internal queue broker.
Follow-ups: automate certificate expiry alerts.
